description: This file implements functions for parsing, validating, and converting secure hardware abstraction layer (HAL) identifiers within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It defines a mapping from string identifiers to enum values, functions to parse strings into enums, validate sets of enums, and convert enums back to strings.

methods.name: ParseSecureHal
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the corresponding SecureHal enum value, case-insensitive, using a predefined mapping.

methods.name: ParseSecureHals
methods.description: Parses a comma or delimiter-separated string into a set of SecureHal enum values.

methods.name: ValidateSecureHals
methods.description: Validates that the set of SecureHal enums contains at most one implementation of keymint, gatekeeper, and oemlock.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a SecureHal enum value to its string representation.
